subject: Kickoff: DReG estimators in the LVM training toolkit
body:
Hi all,

Kicking off the DReG integration. Quick framing for those newer to it: multi-sample IWAE bounds get tighter with more samples, but the standard inference-network gradient estimator counterintuitively degrades as samples grow. Our open-source DReG work showed the popular "sticking the landing" style estimator is actually biased, and that a second application of the reparameterization trick removes the bias and slashes gradient variance. Free accuracy for anyone training latent-variable models.

Product goal: DReG as the default inference-network estimator in the internal LVM toolkit, with variance telemetry so teams can see the win, plus applicability to reweighted wake-sleep style training.

Milestones: estimator module + unit-level variance benchmarks by end of March, two internal adopter models converted in April, toolkit release mid-May.

Bao owns staffing and the (small) compute picture.

Zofia
